**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume restriction on Bluefly:

- **§ 4.1 Charges (p0052):** charges arise only as specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, as one-time, installment, recurring or usage charges — i.e. only for ordered or used Services; **§ 4.2** requires payment only of invoiced amounts due.
- **§ 11.5 Capacity Planning (p0142):** allocates capacity/volume planning responsibility to Customer but commits Customer to no minimum capacity or transaction volume.
- **Exits reinforce this:** § 3.4 permits Customer termination for convenience at the end of any calendar month on one month's notice, and § 13.1 gives a no-termination-charge exit if IBM changes prices or terms.

No redline proposed. Noted for the termination review (not double-flagged here): § 3.4(b) preserves "the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A" — a placeholder that should be confirmed as nil in Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments so it cannot be used to reintroduce a de facto commitment.
